description: Frozen MCP tool catalogue exposed by `advisers mcp --stdio` (tools/list). Additive only: tools are added, never silently removed or renamed; a new tool requires a contract minor update. The checker deep-compares every advertised tool name/inputSchema/annotations with this file.
transport: stdio, one JSON-RPC 2.0 object per line, UTF-8

tools.name: advisers_today
tools.description: Read the open-commitment count and the open commitments (read-only). Returns at most 20 commitment rows; `open`/`total` are the true post-clearance count and `truncated` says rows were withheld. Records belonging to protected matters (matter secrecy above this server clearance, default 0) are excluded and only counted in protectedExcluded.

tools.name: advisers_commit_ls
tools.description: List commitments (open by default; pass all=true for every status). Returns {commitments, total, truncated, limit, clearance, protectedExcluded}; total is the post-clearance row count, so a truncated result is never mistaken for the whole ledger. Read-only. Records belonging to protected matters (matter secrecy above this server clearance, default 0) are excluded and only counted in protectedExcluded.

tools.name: advisers_who
tools.description: Who owes whom: mine (user/agent) versus waiting (third parties). Read-only. Each array is capped at 20 rows; mineTotal/waitingTotal/truncated report the full counts. Records belonging to protected matters (matter secrecy above this server clearance, default 0) are excluded and only counted in protectedExcluded.

tools.name: advisers_evidence
tools.description: Read the source turns for a commitment/fact/preference id. Read-only. Evidence of a protected record is withheld (no id content) and reported as protectedExcluded.

id.description: cm_* commitment, fact_* fact, or pref_* preference id.

tools.name: advisers_remind
tools.description: Read due reminders (no delivery, no network). Returns {reminders, total, truncated, clearance, protectedExcluded}; total is the post-clearance reminder count. Read-only. Records belonging to protected matters (matter secrecy above this server clearance, default 0) are excluded and only counted in protectedExcluded.

tools.name: advisers_capture_candidate
tools.description: Propose a PENDING commitment candidate captured from a quote. This writes a memory candidate only: it never accepts the candidate and never changes the ledger. A human must review it with "advisers memory candidates" and run "advisers memory accept <id>".

action.description: What must be done (verbatim or near-verbatim).

quote.description: The verbatim source text this candidate was captured from.

debtor.description: Who owes the action. Defaults to user.

creditor.description: Who is owed the action. Defaults to someone.

matterId.description: Existing matter id. Defaults to the first active matter.

tools.writeNote: Creates a PENDING memory candidate only; never accepts it and never writes the ledger. A human must accept it with the CLI.

tools.name: advisers_pack_verify
tools.description: Read-only verification of an evidence-pack receipt directory: recomputes SHA256SUMS for manifest.json and README.txt, rejects unsafe or unhashed pack files, and reports whether a receipt.docx is present. Never modifies the directory. The directory path is not echoed in errors.

dir.description: Directory written by "advisers deliveries --pack" (contains manifest.json, README.txt, SHA256SUMS, optionally receipt.docx).

tools.writeNote: Never modifies the receipt directory; reports existence/verification only.

additiveChanges: 0.3.0: advisers_commit_ls inputSchema gained the optional `limit` integer (1..200, default 50); tool names, annotations and the other six inputSchemas are unchanged.
0.3.0: list-shaped tool descriptions now state their output caps and the total/truncated contract; descriptions are documentation snapshots, the checker only requires them to be non-empty.
